tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /gsan yig skabs gsum pa bzhugs so/ /na maḥshrī wān+sad+gu ru ma hā sa twa lo ke shwa rā ya dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sems dpa' chen po 'jig rte
༄༅/ /gsan yig skabs gsum pa bzhugs so/ /na maḥshrī wān+sad+gu ru ma hā sa twa lo ke shwa rā ya dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sems dpa' chen po 'jig rte

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsan yig skabs gsum pa bzhugs so// na maḥshrī wān+sad+gu ru ma hā sa twa lo ke shwa rā ya dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ phun tshogs don gnyis mthar phyin bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /rmad byung bstan pa'i rin chen khang brtsegs ches cher mtho ba'i dbus/ /zab cing rgya che'i man ngag gsang mdzod du ma'i gter mnga' ba/ /dpal ldan bzang po'i phrin las zhabs kyi 'dam skyes rtag tu mchod/ /rje btsun phyag na pad+ma'i rnam par 'phrul pa bud+dha rat+na shrī bha dra zhes grags pa'i gdugs dkar sa gsum du khebs par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid chen po'i drung du dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin nye bar 'tshal ba'i tshul ni/ thog mar rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i gdams ngag lam 'bras dang bcas pa'i khrid legs par thob pa'i skabs su/ rgyu lam gyi dbang yab la sbyar ba dang / yum gyi phyi dkyil dang lus dkyil gyi dbang dang byin rlabs/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyid kyis bsrung ba'i byin rlabs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ brda don gsal ba/ brda gcig brgyud/ sgrub pa lung sbyin/ mgon po dpa' rkyang rnams kyi byin rlabs/ de dag dang 'brel ba'i lung so so rnams dang / bla ma'i rnam thar zhib mo rdo rje/ ngo mtshar snang ba sogs bla ma spyi'i rnam thar dang bye brag gi rnam thar/ lam 'bras glegs bam gyi dkar chag tu thebs pa tshang bar thob cing / lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba rje btsun rin po che bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa gnyis yod pa las/ rgyud kyi le'u'i go rim dang mthun par sbyar ba/ mjug na/ 'di ni bdag cag spun gnyis dang ka lung pa dang rmog ston dang bzhis zhus pa lags/ ces sogs yod pa'i rgyas pa dang / de'i kha skong 'gor gsung ngag rin po che lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba la gsum ste/

gleng gzhi dang / gleng bslang ba dang / rgyud kyi yan lag rgyas par dbye ba dang sbyar ba'o ces sogs dang / mjug tu/ zab dang rgya che'i rnam bshad nor bu ni/ sogs yod pa'i lung sbyor rnams thos/ 'di dag kyang rje nyid kyis sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du gsung ngag tshar gsum dang kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i zhal sngar tshar lnga/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros pa la gsung ngag lan drug gi bar du gsan pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ bla ma se mkhar chung pa/ zhang ston chos 'bar/ sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros/ rgyal ba'i sras po sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag shrī bhū mi paṇ+ḍu ka la'o/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha mngal skyes ltar bskyed pa nag po spyod pa'i lugs kyi rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyad pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha wa ra/ lū hi pa/ dā ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dzā lan+dha ra pa/ nag po spyod pa'i rdo rje/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ phang thing pa sku mched/ klog kya shes rab brtsegs/

mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slon dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ grub chen dkon blo/ rgyal ba'i sras po sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /rim bzhi'i khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gzhan rnams gong bzhin las/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /khrid yig kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa yang thob/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha wa ra/ lū hi pa/ ḍā ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dzā lan+dha ra/ nag po spyod pa'i rdo rje/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ klog kya pa/ mal lo/ /sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun sa paṇa/ bo dong rin po che/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma dam pa/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma kha 'byed pa'i gdams ngag yab la sbyar ba'i khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gong gi dbang brgyud dang gcig la/ khrid yig rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'ang thob/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i lus dkyil du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dzā lan+dha ra/ nag po spyod pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/

glog kya pa/ mal lo/ /rje btsun gong ma lnga/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog paṇa chen shākya shrī/ sa skya paṇa chen g.yag sde la tso ba/ mnga' ris pa sangs rgyas ye shes/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ bla ma dam pa/ rin po che grags tshul ba/ mkhan chen byang chub ye shes/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ nā ro ta pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ klog kya pa/ mal lo/ /sa chen/ rtse mo/ /rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang pa/ na bza' pa/ bla ma dam pa/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub kyi man ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ de nas bo dong pa chos rin dpal/ chos rje dpal ldan rgyal po/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje lha sum cu so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa sa lugs ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ shākya mi tra/ zla ba grags pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ bi k+ṣa ta de ba/ kha che paṇa chen/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/

yang na/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'od zer shākya/ kha'u dar she/ se mo do ra pa rin chen dpal/ ra gnyis pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ sru lung pa kun dga' smon lam/ bla ma grags chen pa/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ gsang ba 'dus pa brgyud pa'i bka' babs bdun ldan du grags pa'i sdog lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ rgyal po bi su kalpa/ bram ze sa ra ha/ nā gārdzu na/ de la.ār+ya de ba/ shākya bshes gnyen/ klu'i byang chub/ zla ba grags pa ste bzhis zhus/ de bzhi la slob pa'i rdo rje/ de nas nag po spyod pa ba/ sa 'dres pa/ de la mar me mdzad/ de ba a kā ra/ bīr+ya bha dra gsum gyis gsan/ de gsum la 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis gsan/ gzhan yang za hor gyi mkhas pa btsun mo can/ bal yul rjong gi nā ga ko ṭi/ bi kra ma shī la'i thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis par grags pa dī paṃ ka ra/ rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po chen po nag po ba/ koṅka la'i mkhas pa chen po rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can/ rgyal po khab kyi mkhas pa chen po dza hūm̐ zhes bya ba zhi ba bzang po/ kha che khri brtan gyi mkhas pa chen po tsan+t+ra ha ri la sogs paṇ+ḍi ta bdun cu/ mkha' 'gro ma'i bla ma gcig dang bcas pa la rje 'gos kyis gsan/ des 'dzad so rong gi mang ra ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ des 'dzad brag ltag gi sdog ye shes seng ge/ des dbon po sdog mu ne rab tu byung ba'i mtshan nyi ma seng ge/ des bres chu bar gyi klad na rtsad tsha nyi ma lcam/ de gnyis la mu ne'i sras ār+ya de ba/ de'i zhar chos pa skyi mkhar 'jug gres kha'i dben tsha'i ltag pa rin chen grags/ de la bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chos 'od kyi rgyud 'grel gyi bshad bka' thob/ yang sdog chen po dang /

klan tsad tsha gnyis la/ snye mo phug ka ba 'bum skyabs/ rong lha steng kyi gtsang ston smra seng / nyang stod spre'u chung gi lce mdo sde seng ge/ yang brag ltag pa chen po la cha kar mon mo brag gi mi nyag rdo rje grags/ de la lce mdo sde seng ge/ de la bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa dge sdings pa chos 'od/ yang klan rtsad tsha la thang spe ba/ grub thob gser sdings pa/ bla ma chos 'od/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ yang thams cad mkhyen pa la blo ldan seng ge/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /mar lugs kyi brgyud pa la/ sgro 'dogs nang nas gcod pa grub thob nyams brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / in+d+ra bhu ti/ ḍā ki bde ba'i zhabs/ ḍoṃ bi he ru ka rdo rje dril bu pa/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ kam+bhal pa/ nag po spyod pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lo tsā ba/ 'tshur dbang gi rdo rje/ 'khon gad pa kīrti/ 'gar ston shes rab rgyal po/ ang phug pa rin chen seng ge/ rong pa shes rab seng ge/ ston mo lung pa ye shes mkhar/ chos 'od/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ khyung lhas pa/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ yang na rdo rje 'chang / byang sems blo gros rin chen/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ma taṃ gi pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lo tsā ba/ 'tshur dbang gi rdo rje/ 'khon gad pa kīrti/ bya khang pa bsod rin/ thur la ba tshul khrims skyabs/ thang spe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ gser lding pa gzhon nu 'od/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od man 'dra'o/ /mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ rgyal po bi su kalpa/ bram ze sa ra ha/

klu sgrub/ ma taṅgi pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa'o/ yang na klu sgrub/ ma taṅgi pa/ zla ba grags pa/ rigs pa'i khu byug ya wa dhū ti pa/ spyod pa'i rdo rje/ nag po zhabs/ dri med blo gros/ dpal ye shes snying pos mar pa la gdams te/ mar pas spyir rgya gar du lan gsum/ bal por lan bzhi ste bdun/ shar/ nub/ lho/ byang / kha che/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta dang / ku sa li grags tshad la bla ma brgya rtsa/ brgyud pa 'dzin nges lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ snang ba 'gyur nges bcu gsum/ 'dus pa la mkhas pa'i bla ma bdun gyi nang nas/ nub du la k+ṣe tra'i gtsug lag khang na gnas pa dpal ye shes snying po las 'dus pa'i dbang rgyud gdams pa'i bka' babs/ khyad par du/ mar pa'i bu bzhi'i nang nas/ 'tshur dbang la/ nā ro pa'i dbang dang rgyud rkyang gdams par bcas pa gdams/ des rje gad pa kīrti/ des mi nyag thur la ba/ dbus pa 'gar dge/ grub thob zhang zhung pa ste thugs sras gsum la de nas gang bar gser kha'i rin chen gling pa tshul khrims mdzes/ rgya pho ba lung pa/ chos grags dpal bzang / shākya gzhon nu/ lce blo ldan seng ge/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ khyung lhas pa/ chos rje shar pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ jo bo lugs kyi dbang bka'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang bdag in+d+ra bhu ti che/ nā gā dzo gi bram ze sa ra ha/ nā gārdzu na zla ba grags pa dang / ku sa li gnyis jo bo a ti sha rong pa 'gar dge lha rje stod pa dang / shes rab rgyal po shes rab gtsug tor dang / lha rje chen po thang stod chos kyi 'od/ /bla chen klog kya bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / /kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal ldan grags pa dpal/ /'dus pa'i dbang dang phran rnams lung thob byas/ /phyis ni bla ma sgom ye'i zhabs drung du/ /bde dges gsang 'dus rgyud 'grel phran bcas thob/ /khong la 'phags pas rgyud 'grel phran bcas gsan/ /de nas bu sten/ khyung lhas pa/

rje rdo rje 'chang man gong bzhin/ chags lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ klu sgrub/ sras kyi thu bo shākya bshes gnyen/ ār+ya de ba/ 'phags pa rta dbyangs/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ rdo rje dril bu/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ dpe med dpal/ gam+bhi ra ma ti/ niska laṅka de wa/ ra wan+d+re/ chag lo tsā ba/ 'u yug dpal la/ yang na klu sgrub/ klu byang / ḍoṃ bi ba/ bī ra ḍi pa/ ma ti gar+bha/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ra wen+t+ra pa/ chag lo tsā ba/ yang na klu sgrub/ zla grags/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ rnam par grags pa'i lha/ rnyog med lha/ ra wen+t+ra pa/ chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/ 'o yug dpal la/ bla ma grags chen pa/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ dpyal lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ kha che paṇa chen yan chad sa lugs dang 'dra/ de nas dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po/ rong pa rga lo/ 'u yug dpal la/ grags chen man gong bzhin/ de ltar brgyud pa'i rim pa smos pa 'di rnams chos kyi byung khungs tsam shes par bya ba'i phyir yin gyi brgyud pa'i gtso bo ni/ da ltar dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i chings dang lag len gyi rim pa rnams ni 'gos dang sa lugs gtso che ba'o/ /gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa thun mong ma yin pa ni/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ba lin+ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal sde/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rin chen rdo rje/ rat+na kīrti/ bla ma paṇ+ḍe pa/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun gong ma lnga/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla ma rdo rje dpal/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa/

ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rje btsun kun dga' dbang phyug kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /jo bo rje'i lugs kyi dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jig rten dbang phyug bcu dgu'i dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ spyan ras gzigs/ jo bo a ti sha lha btsun byang chub 'od/ 'am pa lcags ri ba/ rgya lcags ri gong pa/ rdzing bu kha pa shākya grags/ spen phug dar ma shākya/ zhang ye pa/ gze ba don grub/ bar thang pa yab sras/ bsod nams dbang phyug lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ rje rdo rje 'chang man gong bzhin/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad bskor rwa lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ kā ra rak+ṣi ta/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge/ rwa 'bum seng / rong pa rga lo/ /rong pa shes rab seng ge/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang / chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ bla ma shes rab zla ba/ sngags 'chang rin chen rnam rgyal/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /'jigs byed dpa' gcig pa'i sgrub thabs dri med snang ba/ phyag drug pa'i mngon rtogs khams gsum za byed/ phyag bzhi pa'i mngon rtogs dri med chu rgyun/ phyag gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs rin chen don 'dus/ rtog pa bdun pa'i rgyud rwa lo'i 'gyur/ rtog pa gsum pa/ dī paṃ ka ra dang / lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/ phyag mtshan so gnyis kyi sgrub skor/ dug dbang rma bya rgyas pa'i man ngag cha lag dang bcas pa/ srung bzlog gi man ngag zur 'debs/ rgya ston gyis slob ma gnyis kyi don du mdzad pa/

uṣ+ṇi ṣa rwa lugs kyi yi ge rwa los mdzad pa/ shog ril gsum gyi 'grel pa/ rtog gsum 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag rtog bdun gyi ṭīka rgya ston gyis mdzad pa/ yang 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag 'bri khung dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rnams thos/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhi rim rā la sems bzung ba/ mtshan mo rgyu ba/ mtshan ma gyen bsgreng rnams kyi man ngag thob nas/ de dag gi khrid yig 'bri khung lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā nas mdzad pa thos/ las kyi gshin rje lha bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ bal po thugs rje chen po/ rwa lo tsa ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge/ rwa 'bum seng / rong pa rga lo/ /bla ma mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/ bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ zhang ston bsod grags pa/ gnyan ston chen po rdo rje grags/ jo gdan nam mkha' lhun grub bzang po/ sngags 'chang rin chen rnam rgyal/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /rjes gnang gi yi ge dang / mchod chog thar pa gling pa ār+ya de bas mdzad pa/ yang lha bcu gsum ma'i mchod chog nam mkha' lhun bzang gis mdzad pa rnams thob/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ shākya thub pa/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ rab 'byor skyangs/ kun dga' snying po/ shes rab skyangs/ zhi ba snying po/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ dad byed go cha/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag stengs pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal gyo blo gros grags/ bla ma sa chen/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa paṇa/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ ti shrī kun blo/ chos rje bla ma/ blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/

sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen pa/ des bdag la'o/ /sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gsum kyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ bram ze dzi na mi tra/ swasti phā la/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ pra dz+nyā wa li ta/ ye shes rdo rje/ pra hi ta/ rab 'byor skyangs/ kun dga' snying po/ kha che dharma pā la/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ gnyal pa nyi she/ gnur nyi ma 'od zer/ gshin rdo rje seng ge/ rgya gsar pa/ 'bro dzi ti/ snye mdo pa bsod nams dpal/ gnyal pa chos grags/ bya rin chen 'od/ glo chen sangs rgyas/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal ba/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ chos rje kun bzang / khā phyar byang chub sems dpa'/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ kun dga' snying po/ pradz+nyā pā li/ pradz+nyā bo dhi/ mu ti ko ṣā/ dharma pā la/ dī paṃ ka ra/ go mi sgom chen/ skyi nor dz+nyā na/ gnyal pa nyi she/ gnur nyi 'od/ sras badz+ra singha/ gnur byang 'od/ gnur nyi rgyal/ gnur ye rgyal/ chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ rgyal mtshan grags/ bkra shis rin chen/ rje rdo rje 'chang / mus chen/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ slob dpon snying po'i zhabs/ dze tā ri/ byang chub bzang po/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ bla ma bkra shis 'od/ e pa 'khon ston/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs chen po/ byang sems rgyal ye/ grags pa dpal/ sru lung kun smon/ brag phug pa/

bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan pa/ chos rje shar pa/ kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /tshe dpag med grub pa'i rgyal mo'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ /ti pu pa/ ras chung ba/ mi la ras pa/ dwags po lha rje/ mtha' rtsa ba/ 'bri khung pa/ spyan snga ba/ yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rin chen ldan/ rje zur phug pa/ 'bar ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / chos rje bde legs rin chen/ kun dga' dpal bzang / dbu ma pa dpal ldan bzang po/ drin can dpal ldan mgon po/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /tshe khrid rin chen gter mdzod thob nas/ sngon 'gro thar pa'i sgo 'jug dbang bskur ba'i yi ge/ khrid yig rnams 'bar ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa/ de'i zur 'debs ri khrod pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa thos/ rigs gsum spyi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ in+t+ra bhū ti chen po/ dbu ma pa/ mṛ dhu/ klu sgrub/ klu'i byang chub/ kha che ye shes rdo rje/ lo chung grags mchog shes rab/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ dkar ston shākya grags/ ba de lung pa kun bzang dpal/ gung pa dar ma ye shes/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang / gnyag ston byang chub seng ge/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rje kun dga' bzang po/ bla ma blo gros rin chen/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /grol ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī/ lho brag pa byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi ba grags gzhon/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po/

grub chen dkon mchog blo gros/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /dpal dur sol lha mo'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lo tsā ba/ rngog gzhung pa/ chos sdings pa/ shas sgang pa/ gnyag ston chen po/ gnyag dge bshes/ mus pa mdo sde grags/ slob dpon jo ye/ gnyag gnas gsar ba/ gle lung jo sras/ ma gcig dgon chung ma/ mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal/ gug shrī rin po che/ slob dpon smon lam rdo rje/ bsod nams blo gros/ sngags 'chang mchog rgyal ba/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ pad+ma badz+ra/ shrī badz+ra rā hu la/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ dz+nyā na sid+dhi/ dpal dam tshig rdo rje/ 'chi med blo gros bzang po/ bai ro tsa na/ kham pa rga lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ bla ma yar sgom/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin can seng ge bzang po/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'khon blo gros rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan rgyal po/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang dang / sgrub thabs yi ge rnying pa sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i lung dang / yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub lag len gyi zur 'debs kyang thos/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lha bcu gnyis kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ shād+dha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag stengs pa/ sa chen kun snying / slob dpon rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa/ sa skya paṇa chen/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/

chos rje bla ma/ bzhi thog pa kun dga' rin chen/ bdag chen grags pa blo gros/ bdag chen blo gros dbang phyug sngags 'chang rin chen rnam rgyal/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang dang / nang sgrub 'jam rtsub kyi khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ lo chen rin bzang / brag stengs pa/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rtse mo/ /rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin can seng ge bzang po/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog bdag chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan rgyal po/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /nang sgrub kyi khrid yig yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa dang / rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig gnyis/ man ngag bran tshegs dang bcas pa/ bdag chen chos gyi rje blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i phyi+i'i sbags sgrub lha brgyad la sbyar ba/ mgon po'i man ngag gi khog bsgrigs de nyid kyis mdzad pa/ nag po chen po'i bris sku bsgrub pa'i shog ril/ gri gug kā pā la/ gaṇ+ḍi/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ral gri/ thug chen/ rnga chen/ pho nya bsgrub pa rnams kyi shog ril dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa thos so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdud kyi gcod yul thob pa'i pho brgyud ni/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge/ bram ze ār+ya de ba/ rje btsun dam pa rgya gar/ pho brgyud chung ba/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa/ byams pa mgon po/ 'phags pa thogs med/ paṇa chen dbyig gnyen/ ār+ya de ba/ dam pa mo brgyud ni/ yum chen/ 'phags ma sgrol ma/

su kha sid+dhi/ dam pa rgya gar/ dam pa man don gyi brgyud pa yin/ de nas skyo ston ye shes bla ma/ skyo chung bsod nams bla ma/ ma cig lab kyi sgron ma/ khu sgom chos seng / dbus pa zang thal/ grub thob rgya nag gcer bu/ rgya sgom ri/ sangs rgyas rab ston/ skye med do pa chos shes/ rtogs ldan lhas ston zhig po/ zhig po thog brdugs/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ rgyal ba mus pa chen po/ bla ma rdo rje bsod nams/ 'gro sgom nam mkha' dpal/ rin po che nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ yang na kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ /sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i khrid yig che chung gnyis kyang thos/ sgra mi snyan gyi rang gzungs kyi brgyud pa ni/ dgra bcom pa blo gros dpal/ hang du/ tsan+d+ra/ slob dpon dar ma grags/ bla ma mnga' ris pa ye shes rgyal po/ shes rab grags/ dz+nyā na sid+dhi/ de'i gcung po slob dpon bsod nams mgon/ rin chen seng ge/ bu ston rin chen grub/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag pa'o/ /theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i 'khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang / byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa grol sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ gu na mi tra/ seng ge bzang po/ gang ba spel/ ku sa li che chung / gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston/ pu to ba/ shā ra ba/ 'chad ka ba/ se spyil bu ba/ lha spyil bu ba/ lha sdings pa/ lha sdings dbon/ yon tan dpal/ bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi pa grags gzhon/ rin po che bsod nams grags/ rgyal sras thogs med/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rje kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po rje sangs rgyas rin chen/

des bdag la'o/ /yang na rgyal sras thogs med yan gong dang 'dra/ de nas sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims dpal/ sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan man gong bzhin/ blo sbyong gi man ngag thor bu ba rnams thob pa'i rnam grangs la/ jo bo rjes rgyal srid spangs de thar pa bsgrub pa'i rnam thar 'brom ston gyis mdzad pa/ jo bo mnyam med gser gling pa dang mjal ba'i rnam thar/ blo sbyong don bdun ma'i gzhung mchan yod pa dang med pa/ blo sbyong don bdun ma'i 'grel pa/ blo sbyong mtshon cha 'khor lo/ blo sbyong rma bya dug 'joms/ gyer sgom rdo rje'i glu/ byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i blo sbyong / blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa/ blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las rang rgyud ngan pa dma' dbab pa/ sems dpa'i rim pa las zas dge ba'i stobs bskyed pa/ gser gling pas jo bo la mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i ched du gnang ba'i blo sbyong / nyon mongs lam du blang ba'i man ngag bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ theg chen 'khon sbyong / jo bo la rnal 'byor ma gnyis kyis sems sbyong zhig ces gnang ba'i blo sbyong / ku sa li'i tshogs gsog skyid sdug lam 'khyer/ sum pa lo tsā ba la mkha' 'gro mas gnang ba'i blo sbyong / kun tu bzang po'i blo sbyong / blo sbyong thun brgyad ma/ zas la brten pa'i blo sbyong / dbugs la brten pa'i blo sbyong / lus gaṅga klung gi phye ma snyed du sprul nas rigs drug gi rdul dang du len pa'i blo sbyong / sha khrag la brten pa'i blo sbyong / gtor ma la brten pa'i blo sbyong / 'byung ba la brten pa'i blo sbyong / lus ngag yid bzhin nor bur bsgyur ba'i blo sbyong / 'chi kha ma'i blo sbyong / gegs sel blo sbyong / ma 'ongs pa'i 'gal rkyen spong ba'i blo sbyong / jo bo'i blo sbyong don bdun ma/ mchims kyi blo sbyong /

rnam dag bcu gcig nor bu la gnang ba'i blo sbyong / blo sbyong tshig rkang brgyad ma lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ glang thang pa'i tshig rkang brgyad ma'i 'grel pa/ a ti sha la gser gling pas mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i ched du gnang ba'i blo sbyong / theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong zhes pa'i dpe tshan zhig zhang rat+na gu ru'i tshogs chos chen mo/ yang dgon pa'i blo sbyong / rten 'brel snying po'i khrid yig rje sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i blo sbyong gi zin bris gnyis/ gcod kyi yi ge che chung gnyis rnams thos so// ༈ /chos rje rin po che sangs rgyas rin chen pa'i zhal nas gsung 'bum gyi lung thob pa la/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcom ldan 'das ma nyid la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i rnam thar/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros pa'i rnam thar rtsa 'grel/ rje dkon mchog 'phel ba'i rnam thar/ lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi rnam bshad/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i khrid yig kha skong dang bcas pa/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig bshad pa/ 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i mngon rtogs/ lū hi pa'i bskyed rim bshad pa/ de'i sgrub mchod kyi zur 'debs/ bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub kyi yi ge/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi cho ga'i zur 'debs/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil gyi gsal byed/ de'i bkra shis/ mgon po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang yi ge/ de'i nang sgrub 'jam rtsub kyi 'khrid yig gnyis/ 'khor rkyang gi rjes gnang byed tshul sogs man ngag thor bu tshan zhig dpal dur sol lha mo'i rjes gnang / gtor chog bskang gso'i yi ge/ dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang / gtor chog chom rkun bcing ba'i las tshogs/ sa lugs kyi 'chi bdag 'joms pa dang / tshe dpag med lha dgu ma'i dbang chog ngan song sbyong rgyud brtag pa phyi ma nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gcig dbang bskur ba'i zur 'debs sa skya pa'i lugs/

sgrol ma dkar mo 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang byed tshul/ seng ge sgra'i mngon rtogs/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa dang / 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang byed thabs/ don yod zhags pa'i gzungs sgrub byed lugs kyi lag len/ nor sbyin 'khor lo'i sgrub yig e waṃ nas 'bul bsdud pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i byin rlabs byed tshul/ gcod gdan thog gcig tu nyams su blang tshul lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don/ kyai rdo rje'i rtsa sngags kyi bshad pa/ bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa'i phyag len rnams thob bo/ /mi mnyam pa yi bri rta'i nang / /kha sgo zhes pa'i sdeb sbyor yin/ (pra ṇa mo bud+dha rū pa twa)(rat+na bi shwaka dharma s+ya)(nidhi saṃ gha)(sa mu dra s+ya)(se ba shrī bha dra pa r+shā shwe)sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin nyid/ /dam chos rin chen sna tshogs gter/ /dge 'dun rgya mtshos bsten pa'i dpal/ /bzang po'i zhabs la rtag tu 'dud/ /dam pa gang gi drin las legs bshad nye bar thos pa'i dpal/ /dbyar skyes rnga chen sgrog cing sim byed char rgyun rab phab pa'i/ /gtsug phud can gyi dga' ba la yang khengs pa 'phrog byed pa/ /rab dga'i rgyal sras gzhon nu ji bzhin srid zhi'i bde ba rnyed/ /khyed kyi mkhyen pa'i rta ljang dkyil 'khor las/ /thugs rje'i 'od stong rab tu 'phros pa yis/ /bdag blo pad+ma'i tshal rab rgyas pa dang / /nag phyogs 'byung po'i chogs rnams zhum par gyur/ /lhag par tshe rabs skye ba'i dus kun du/ lhag pa'i tshul khrims gos kyi nyer mdzes shing / /lhag pa'i sems dang lhag pa'i shes rab ldan/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog thugs kyis 'dzin par shog legs par bshad pa'i gsung rab thos pa'i tshul mdo tsam brjod pa pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba las/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sems dpa' chen po bud+dha rat+na shrī bha dra'i zhal sngar rdo rje theg pa sogs nye bar nos pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o//
